io.mavlink4j.session.TxScheduler

Packages that use TxScheduler
Package
Description
io.mavlink4j.service
L4 — one class per MAVLink microservice (command, parameter, heartbeat, manual control, message interval, capability).
io.mavlink4j.session
L3 — the MavlinkSession composition root: reader threads, peer directory, dispatcher, correlator, TX scheduler.
io.mavlink4j.testkit
Test doubles for code that talks MAVLink through mavlink4j, with no SITL, socket or hardware needed: a scripted FakeVehicle, in-memory links (RecordingLink, LoopbackLinkPair) and deterministic time (ManualInstantSource, DirectTxScheduler).

    Methods in io.mavlink4j.session that return TxScheduler
    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    static TxScheduler
    TxScheduler.pooled(MavlinkSettings settings)
    A scheduler backed by its own small thread pool (MavlinkSettings.txPoolSize() threads from MavlinkSettings.threadFactory()), for a caller that wants one outside a MavlinkSession — a session already owns one, see MavlinkSession.scheduler().
    TxScheduler
    MavlinkSession.scheduler()
    The one TX scheduler this session owns; closed with the session.

    Classes in io.mavlink4j.testkit that implement TxScheduler
    Modifier and Type
    Class
    Description
    final class 
    DirectTxScheduler
    A TxScheduler with no threads and no timers: DirectTxScheduler.submit(java.lang.String, java.lang.Runnable) runs inline and a DirectTxScheduler.repeat(java.lang.String, java.time.Duration, java.lang.Runnable) registration only fires when the test calls DirectTxScheduler.tick().
